title: MCP session start refreshes the ledger via an unref'd 30 s timer that spawns a detached snapshot, only from the real stdio entrypoint
context: A machine that only ever runs an agent must still report its branches. Spawning at server construction made existing tests that count overlay commits across in-process or stdio MCP sessions nondeterministic (constitution.test.ts).
decision: `startServer` (the `hunch mcp` stdio entrypoint) enables `workspaceRefresh`; `buildServerWithRootControl` arms an unref'd setTimeout (HUNCH_WORKSPACE_REFRESH_DELAY_MS, default 30 s) that spawns `hunch workspaces snapshot --quiet` detached with this installation's launcher (verificationLauncherFor), HUNCH_SYNC=1, only when a snapshot has a home. In-process servers (tests, embedders) never spawn; HUNCH_WORKSPACE_REFRESH=0 opts out.
consequences: Sessions shorter than the delay never trigger it, which is what makes the test suite deterministic.
The snapshot no-ops when nothing changed and the stored record is under a day old.
alternatives_rejected: Spawn immediately at server construction — races tests that assert overlay commit counts.
Run the snapshot in-process synchronously — blocks the MCP event loop for seconds on large repos.
Gate on a test-runner env var (NODE_TEST_CONTEXT) — undocumented and hacky.
